From the header's Judge (6) only: the platoon commander runs PlatoonHillAttack, the tanks fire, both T-72s die (the take's first shot comes at 210.7 s, so the run is long). (1)-(5) need a round's muzzle point, exposure spans and heading, none of which a shot row or a component carries; 300 s may be short for both kills. A platoon, so no golden.
